source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
While this model leads a unit, that unit's models have **[Deep Strike](vsdata:core-ability/deep-strike)**, and:

- During any Charge, Fall Back, Advance or Normal move, they can pass horizontally over models and terrain features.
- During an Advance, Fall Back or Normal move, they can enter enemy models' Engagement Range but cannot end the move in it.
- During an Advance, Fall Back or Normal move, they pass any Desperate Escape test automatically.

grants.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 2 of 24 sampled ability grants of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
